header.name: Likith K G
header.summary: Software Development Engineer with 2+ years of experience in backend development, data processing, and AI/LLM automation. Strong expertise in Python, Flask, Node.js, microservices, and scalable data pipelines.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering in Information Science and Engineering

bullet_points: Built Python/Flask and Node.js microservices to process Avro/Parquet data and load transformed results into PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch via REST APIs.
Redesigned a 2–3 GB data processing workflow to eliminate intermediate CSV disk I/O, using PyArrow, fastavro, and chunked/asynchronous processing to meet a ~2-minute processing window.
Translated infrastructure troubleshooting SOPs into structured AI skill instructions by decomposing procedures and iteratively testing workflows against real-world incidents.

projects.name: Cloud Service Observability & Monitoring Platform
bullet_points: Designed an event-driven architecture using Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time cross-cloud resource monitoring.
Implemented JWT-based role-based access control (RBAC) to secure sensitive monitoring data.
Containerized the application suite using Docker for consistent deployment across environments.

projects.name: Heart Disease Prediction System — ML Backend
bullet_points: Developed a REST API backend to serve ML inference for heart disease prediction.
Built an end-to-end pipeline covering data preprocessing, model training, and inference evaluation using precision-recall metrics.
